text:
ana: New contributor report: onboarding CLI is noisy when OpenTelemetry is enabled and some retry logs lack req_id. Also a header leaked an email-like string in a debug line.

ben: Oof. How to repro?

ana: Steps: `git checkout samples/onboard-cli && npm ci && TELEMETRY=on ./bin/onboard start --dev`. Watch logs. Snip: 
```
2026-05-05T09:01:02.100Z INFO onboard-cli starting
2026-05-05T09:01:02.200Z DEBUG undici request to https://api.redwood/v1/complete
2026-05-05T09:01:02.201Z DEBUG undici raw-headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX user_email=jamie@example.com
2026-05-05T09:01:02.202Z DEBUG retry attempt=1 no req_id present
```

ana: The Authorization header is redacted by our logger, but `user_email` is leaking. When RETRY_POLICY=aggressive we get multiple retry lines that often don't contain req_id.

ben: Which SDK is the sample using? Hook ordering changed in 0.9.x so OTEL-first vs logging-first matters for injection timing.

ana: package.json shows "redwood-sdk": "0.8.9" and we experimented with `TELEMETRY_HOOK_ORDER=otel_first`.

pat: Sounds like two issues: (1) hook ordering + SDK old pin -> logs emitted before req_id is injected, (2) our header sanitizer misses `snake_case` keys like `user_email` and non-standard header formats. Also retry middleware logs before the final logging wrapper in some code paths.

ben: Short-term fixes: bump the sample to ^0.9.2 (parity with injector order fixes), default onboarding env to `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info`, and add a defensive sanitize pass in the lowest-level HTTP primitive to scrub email regex and tokens.

ana: I did `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info` locally and noise reduced, but I still saw a single undici internal debug line that printed raw headers. A pre-send scrub in our fetch wrapper should catch that.

pat: For retries, ensure req_id is attached to the request context before any retry logging runs. That means moving req_id injection earlier in the middleware chain (or having retry logs include a placeholder that gets backfilled). We shipped a backfill helper in the SDK but older pins don't include it.

ben: Action plan: (1) sample bump to ^0.9.2, (2) add `normalizeAndScrubHeaders(headers)` called in the HTTP primitive before any call out, covering header keys like `user_email`, `user-email`, `user`, and values matching email/token/ip regexes, (3) change retry middleware to call `ensureReqId()` at start of attempt and add a best-effort `req_id=unknown` tag if injection isn't available, (4) CI logs-scan job that runs sample with `TELEMETRY_HOOK_ORDER=otel_first` and `RETRY_POLICY=aggressive` and fails if any log line matches email regex.

ana: Can we keep the scrub conservative? We don't want to redact every alphanumeric string. Maybe only redact when key name includes "user"/"email" or when value matches an email/token pattern.

pat: Agreed. Also add telemetry: a metric for "log-scrubbed" events so we can monitor how often we redact in onboarding samples.

ben: I'll open a PR that bumps package.json, adds the sanitize + metric, and updates quickstart note: "If you see many DEBUG network logs or missing req_id, set REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info or upgrade the sample SDK. Use TELEMETRY_HOOK_ORDER only for advanced debugging."

ci-bot: CI triggered for branch ben/onboard-telemetry-scrub. Jobs queued: lint, unit, logs-scan. :gear:

ana: Thanks — leaving the dev instance running to validate once CI green. Also tagging docs-team to add a short troubleshooting bullet about req_id + retries.

ben: Will ping docs in PR description. Thanks all :rocket:
